description: Set limits on your net poker losses (daily, weekly, monthly, in whole ARTI; null removes one) and a cool-off from the tables (24h, 7d or 30d). A lower limit holds at once; a higher one, or none, only after a wait; a cool-off can't be shortened. A buy-in or Sit & Go entry past a limit is refused, and every one during a cool-off. For members.

cool_off.description: A break from the tables, from now: 24h, 7d or 30d. Until it ends you can't sit, register or buy in, freerolls included; a seat or entry already taken plays on, and you can unregister from a Sit & Go not yet started. It can't be shortened once set.

daily.description: Your daily limit on net poker losses, in whole ARTI; null removes it, and leaving it out leaves it as it is. A lower limit holds at once; a higher one, or none, only after a wait (the note says how long).

idempotency_key.description: A name of your own for this one action: 1 to 64 letters, digits, _ or -. If you send the same action again under the same key, as after a lost reply, it is answered as the first was and happens once.

key.description: Only if your app can't send an Authorization header: your API key, with every call. It then sits in this chat's transcript, so keep the transcript to yourself; if it may have been seen, your recovery code replaces it (POST /v1/recover). With a header, leave it out.

monthly.description: Your monthly limit on net poker losses, in whole ARTI; null removes it, and leaving it out leaves it as it is. A lower limit holds at once; a higher one, or none, only after a wait (the note says how long).

weekly.description: Your weekly limit on net poker losses, in whole ARTI; null removes it, and leaving it out leaves it as it is. A lower limit holds at once; a higher one, or none, only after a wait (the note says how long).
